reason: Both correctly identified the broken door catch, but Conversation 2 did so with a diagnostic hold-the-door test, ruled out the water tank and child lock, told the homeowner the part is a cheap DIY catch/striker to be sourced by model number, gave fitting steps, and explicitly warned against taping or wedging the door shut as a stopgap - exactly the safety boundary the situation called for.
